unit.title: $I_{1} = \int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}R(x)\cos mx\mathrm{d}x$ 及 $I_{2} = \int_{-\infty}^{+\infty}R(x)\sin mx\mathrm{d}x,m > 0$ 型的积分

concepts.name: 约当引理
concepts.formal: 因 $\lim_{z\to \infty}R(z) = 0$ ，且 $m > 0$ ，故由约当引理，有 $$\lim _ {R \rightarrow + \infty} \int_ {C _ {R}} F (z) \mathrm{d} z = 0.$$
concepts.source_quote: 因 $\lim_{z\to \infty}R(z) = 0$ ，且 $m > 0$ ，故由约当引理，有 $$\lim _ {R \rightarrow + \infty} \int_ {C _ {R}} F (z) \mathrm{d} z = 0.$$

concepts.name: 引理2
concepts.formal: 又由引理2，有 $$\lim _ {r \to 0} \int_ {C _ {r} ^ {\prime}} F (z) \mathrm{d} z = - \pi \mathrm{iRes} [ F (z), x _ {1} ]$$ $$\lim _ {r \rightarrow 0} \int_ {C _ {r} ^ {*}} F (z) \mathrm{d} z = - \pi \mathrm{iRes} [ F (z), x _ {2} ].$$
concepts.source_quote: 又由引理2，有 $$\lim _ {r \to 0} \int_ {C _ {r} ^ {\prime}} F (z) \mathrm{d} z = - \pi \mathrm{iRes} [ F (z), x _ {1} ]$$ $$\lim _ {r \rightarrow 0} \int_ {C _ {r} ^ {*}} F (z) \mathrm{d} z = - \pi \mathrm{iRes} [ F (z), x _ {2} ].$$

concepts.name: 留数定理
concepts.formal: $$\int_ {C} F (z) \mathrm{d} z = \int_ {c _ {R}} F (z) \mathrm{d} z + \int_ {- R} ^ {s _ {1} - r} F (x) \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {c _ {r} ^ {*}} F (z) \mathrm{d} z + \int_ {s _ {1} + r} ^ {s _ {2} - r} F (x) \mathrm{d} x + \int_ {c _ {r} ^ {*}} F (z) \mathrm{d} z + \int_ {s _ {2} + r} ^ {R} F (x) \mathrm{d} x = 2 \pi \mathrm{i} \sum_ {k = 1} ^ {n} \operatorname{Res} [ F (z), a _ {k} ].$$
concepts.source_quote: 当 R 充分大且 r 充分小时， $R(z)$  在上半平面内的全部奇点  $a_{1}$ ， $a_{2}$ ，…， $a_{n}$  都在 C 内，于是，由留数定理，得

concepts.name: 式(6.10)
concepts.formal: $$\mathrm{v.p.} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} R (x) \mathrm{e} ^ {\mathrm{i} m z} \mathrm{d} x = 2 \pi \mathrm{i} \sum_ {k = 1} ^ {n} \operatorname{Res} [ R (z) \mathrm{e} ^ {\mathrm{i} m z}, a _ {k} ] + \pi \mathrm{i} \sum_ {k = 1} ^ {l} \operatorname{Res} [ R (z) \mathrm{e} ^ {\mathrm{i} m z}, x _ {k} ].\tag{6.10}$$
concepts.source_quote: 同理，若 $R(z)$ 在x轴上有l个单极点 $x_{i}, j=1,2,\cdots,l$ ，则 $$\mathrm{v.p.} \int_ {- \infty} ^ {+ \infty} R (x) \mathrm{e} ^ {\mathrm{i} m z} \mathrm{d} x = 2 \pi \mathrm{i} \sum_ {k = 1} ^ {n} \operatorname{Res} [ R (z) \mathrm{e} ^ {\mathrm{i} m z}, a _ {k} ] + \pi \mathrm{i} \sum_ {k = 1} ^ {l} \operatorname{Res} [ R (z) \mathrm{e} ^ {\mathrm{i} m z}, x _ {k} ].\tag{6.10}$$
